purpose: Teach: 市中/汝/減退/ゴシップ/小声/快挙/真田/悪戯

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、市中、つまり市中銀行の金融研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, in your essay you took up financial research on commercial banks — the ones out in the market — didn't you.
lines.style: Calm teacher's opener, warm and even, gentle lift on her name, confirming rather than quizzing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、聖書の汝、つまり「汝」の二人称研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I did the one on the biblical 'thou,' that old-fashioned way of saying 'you.'
lines.style: Quick teen 'yes,' a little self-conscious, speeding up over the explanation, faint pride underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 高齢者の体力減退の医学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered the medical research on physical decline in the elderly.
lines.style: Softer, reflective pacing, the tone of moving a finger down a checklist.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、メディアのゴシップ報道の倫理研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yep — and the ethics of gossip reporting in the media.
lines.style: Brighter on 'gossip,' small amused edge, teenager warming up to the topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 図書館での小声、つまり小声会話の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Then the study on whispering — hushed conversations in the library.
lines.style: Voice playfully dipping quieter on 'whispering,' a smile carried in the cadence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、宇宙開発の快挙、つまり成功例の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes! And the big feats in space development — all the success stories.
lines.style: Genuine spark of excitement, quicker tempo, the guard dropping for a moment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦国武将真田氏の戦術研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the tactics of the Sanada clan, the Warring States commanders — that was you as well.
lines.style: Deliberate, quietly impressed weight on the historical names, brief approving pause.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、児童の悪戯、つまり悪戯心理の発達研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Uh-huh — and the last one, how kids' mischief develops, the psychology behind their pranks.
lines.style: Relieved, lighter close, small laugh tucked under the words as she finishes the list.
